Package org.cyborgcats.ssm

Class State

java.lang.Object
org.cyborgcats.ssm.State
public class State extends Object
Represents a named machine state composed of a single Step. States are managed by the Scheduler and may chain to cleanup or finish states upon interruption or natural completion, respectively.

    • withIgnoreDisable

      public State withIgnoreDisable(boolean ignoreDisable)
      Sets whether this state keeps running while the robot is disabled.

      By default a state is ended by the Scheduler as soon as the robot is disabled, exactly as if it had been interrupted. Setting this to true exempts the state, so it continues to advance every loop regardless of enable status.

      Parameters:
      ignoreDisable - true to keep running while disabled, false to be ended
      Returns:
      this state for chaining

    • onEnd

      public void onEnd(Runnable callback)
      Registers a callback to invoke when this state's step completes on its own. This callback does not run when the state is interrupted by a conflicting state, nor when it is ended explicitly via Scheduler.end(State) or Scheduler.endAll(). To react to interruption, use onInterrupt(Runnable).
      Parameters:
      callback - the runnable to invoke on natural completion
